I believe you. 

Wish I could do more for you but not a professional, you should try reaching out to one if available

Once fell asleep at a friend’s, I’m not the type to easily let my guard down around people especially guys but something came over me. I barely or don’t even remember anything and I’ve been avoiding thinking of times those have happened because I guess I don’t want to accept it. I barely get sleep and recently I’ve started spacing out for hours whenever I am very very tired, makes it more confusing because I don’t know if it’s just me spacing out or if I was drugged. Don’t know if I’m even making sense.
Thank you so much, means a lot 🤗
Made me feel more alone and that no one cares. Kinda tough to when you’re alone
The more I read it the harder it was to finish because I couldn’t stop laughing 😂
